store: Cloth Rack, Sol 6.1 / extra high: r1 spinner's cabinet, actual five textile kinds in separate bundle lanes
space: Unity metres: ux=-bx,uy=bz,uz=-by. Quaternion xyzw. OBJ forward NEGATIVE_Z/up Y, existing loader flips x.
fill_order: Per bay group 0..7: four units in ascending layer order. Each physical bay has left and right bundle lanes. One assigned kind per lane; a physical bay may contain two separate kinds. Earlier same-kind copies support later ones. Missing known copies_by_item must fail; copies is only planned-home fallback.
unit_semantics: copy offset locates true bounds centre at unit.position+offset; quat_xyzw rotates the item; fit_longest_m fits its original longest bounds side. Unit.box bottom is 3 cm below the plank to leave actual triangle-contact poses unaffected by rotated-bounds safety lift.
